title: Must-ship lots

expected.says: the report for this season's lots matches the expected report

blueprint.contract: Takes the lots as read. Returns the names of the must-ship lots, in input order; an empty tuple when there are none.
blueprint.idea: A must-ship lot is a variable fixed to 1 before the search starts.

blueprint.signature: def best_selection(lots: list[Lot], capacity: int) -> tuple[str, ...]
blueprint.contract: Returns the names of the chosen lots in input order: every must-ship lot, then the most valuable fit for the room they leave. Raises ValueError when the must-ship lots alone weigh more than the capacity.
blueprint.idea: Fix the forced variables, take their weight off the capacity, and solve the smaller knapsack over the free lots.

blueprint.contract: Reads name, weight, value and an optional must column. A must cell of yes, y or true, in any case, marks the lot; anything else, or no column, does not.
blueprint.idea: Input data decides which variables are fixed, so read it strictly and once.

blueprint.signature: def render(lots: list[Lot], chosen: tuple[str, ...], capacity: int) -> str
blueprint.contract: One line per chosen lot in input order, starred when it must ship, then the total weight and the total value.
blueprint.idea: A report says which decisions were forced and which were chosen.

cases: the must column marks the lots that have to ship
